thread:
maria: just finished an nsys + perfetto sweep on the prod-sim workload after the kernel_selector change. uploaded trace: https://perf-traces.internal/trace/ghi789. timeline shows lots of tiny kernels interleaved with big matmuls and a clear correlation with KV cache misses during micro-batches.

devon: can you paste the NVTX ranges you had? curious how coarse they are today.

maria: currently we only emit two ranges: RUNTIME_REQUEST and KERNEL_EXEC. that hides per-request batching boundaries. i can see many tiny kernels that get attributed to the big outer span — makes it hard to tie kernel aliases back to the originating request.

jules: that's the regression i saw in the A/B. batching heuristic started splitting when seq_len variance within a batch exceeded ~0.55 and it creates micro-batches with zero KV locality. memory traffic spikes.

shawn: if kvcache ranges are too coarse, nsys aggregates misses under the outer span and we lose signal. we need per-request spans + explicit kvcache:hit/miss ranges so tool grouping shows the right hotspots.

maria: proposed NVTX naming (compact, parseable):
- outer (per-request) -> req:route=chat:mdl=gptj6b:b=4:slen=512:seq_bin=mid
- kvcache -> kvcache:hit:key=1a2b3c OR kvcache:miss
- kernel -> kernel:alias=matmul_tiled_v3:ks=selector42
keep hashes to 6 chars to avoid bloat, and prefer snake_case. overall string cap ~120 bytes.

devon: prefer numeric slen tag (slen=512) rather than embedding long seq text. also +1 on short key. regex-friendly tokens will help automated parsing.

jules: also suggest gating per-request spans: emit only when (slen >= 384) OR (batch_split=true) OR (trace_level>=2). otherwise stick to outer coarse span to avoid push/pop overhead.

shawn: FYI measured nvtx push/pop overhead on sm80: ~50ns in tight loop. it's small but matters at tens of millions of requests. recommend runtime flags: nvtx.enabled + nvtx.sampling_rate (default 1/2000) and a small deterministic sampler when running in prod-sim.

perf-bot: trace uploaded: https://perf-traces.internal/trace/ghi789  nsys_profile=1781234600  length=110s

devon: concrete action items:
1) add per-request NVTX outer span with pattern above (use 6-char key).
2) emit kvcache:hit/miss ranges around the lookup path.
3) annotate kernel exec pushes with kernel_selector id and alias (ks=...).
4) add nvtx runtime flag + sampling policy default 1/2000 and a gating expression for slen/batch_split/trace_level.

jules: i'll draft a tiny PR with macros that are no-op when NVTX is disabled:
- NVTX_SCOPE_REQ(req, route, mdl, batch_id, slen, seq_bin)
- NVTX_NOTE_KVCACHE(hit, short_key)
- NVTX_NOTE_KERNEL(alias, ks_id)
I'll add unit tests that validate string formatting and length limits.

maria: i'll add perfetto capture guidance to eng-runtime/perf README and an example nsys command for the critical 10s window. suggestion for perfetto config: circular buffer 64MB, monotonic clock, enable nvtx + gpu counters, and record ~5 minutes at sampling=10k for flame graphs. then nsys for the focused 10-30s window.

shawn: add ks=<selector_id> to kernel nvtx so we can grep traces and build selector->outcome dashboards. includes mis-picked quantized kernels.

devon: ping me with the PR link. i'd like a short annotated trace example (sanitized keys) to validate perfetto filters and our dashboard ingestion.

maria: will post PR + sanitized example trace in eng-runtime/perf. note: scrub any PII and secrets before sharing externally.

jules: small reminder: nvtx strings in some viewers are truncated; keep key info early in the string. also avoid embedding long hashes.

maria: thanks team :thumbsup:

perf-bot: reminder: traces may contain secrets. run trace-scrubber before external sharing.
